scope: spritesheets only; not integrated or published

characters.name: Urso de papel verde-menta — identificação provisória
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production animation SPRITESHEET for PipaKlub, adapting the original creature in INPUT IMAGE 1 to the game's sprite style in INPUT IMAGE 2. Image1 is strict CHARACTER IDENTITY and palette reference, not layout. Image2 (Hiponilo) is ONLY style/outline/faceted-paper shading reference: absolutely NO hippo, ornate jewelry, crown, back kite sail, bells, crystals or added props. Output SQUARE preferably2048x2048, exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows,16 separate FULL BODY animation frames. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard artwork, no solid background, NO labels/text/palette/portraits/grid lines. All figures same size, same fixed 3/4 front view facing slightly RIGHT, head and torso centered on same pivot across frames. Every creature silhouette plus scarf completely contained within central55-60% of its own cell, with generous transparent margins >=18%each side. Do not touch sheet boundaries or adjacent cells.
IDENTITY MUST MATCH INPUT1: original small bipedal mint-green BEAR made of subtly folded living kite paper; large angular rounded mint head, exactly TWO round ears with segmented pale mint rims and lavender-pink inner ears, amber/gold irises, small black pupils and white sclera, two small PINK eyebrow ovals, tiny dark triangular nose, determined cute expression, THREE-point leaflike mint forehead mark, pale mint oval belly. Exactly TWO short arms each ending in a small three-notched mitten paw and TWO short legs with small three-toed feet. Golden thin string ties at shoulders and ankles as in original. ONE pink folded-paper SCARF around neck with large sparse plum-purple spots and a single long ribbon end flowing to the LEFT behind the body, continuously attached to neck in every frame. Preserve round ear symmetry, forehead mark, nose, and scarf spot pattern. No fuzzy fur, no tail, no wings, no costume, no new decorative items.
ART STYLE: clean dark navy outline, crisp subtle stair-step/pixel clusters and angular paper planes, 2D illustration midway refined pixel art,3 shades per paper material, no3D or painterly glossy realism. More compact game-readable proportions than anime turnaround, but same character design. Strong clear facial features at96px.
ANIMATION ORDER read left-to-right:
ROW1 frames00–03 IDLE: centered neutral alert pose, tiny torso breathing motion, arms loosen slightly, brief blink on frame01, scarf tip gently undulates. Last returns near first.
ROW2 frames04–07 FLIGHT: same body scale and facing, gentle airborne tuck with knees flexing and arms slightly open; four sequential articulations, paper scarf waves with attached root. No walking turnaround and no whole-character sliding.
ROW3 frames08–11 SKILL visual sequence: anticipation lean/back arm draw; gather with both paws close to torso; short committed forward paper-paw swipe with torso twist, scarf sweeps smoothly behind without becoming disconnected; recovery to neutral. No detached VFX, particles, speed streaks, extra limbs or giant glow.
ROW4 frames12–13 HURT: small recoil with squint and shoulders raised, then recovery; frames14–15 VICTORY: small joyful fist pump then smiling relaxed celebration, facial changes and scarf articulation visible, same body dimensions.
Do not duplicate identical frames. Preserve torso size, head size and all anatomy across the16poses. Actual opaque mint body and opaque pink scarf, only background and gaps transparent. One mint bear in each cell, nothing else.

characters.name: Ciclope de papel — identificação provisória
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished GAME ANIMATION SPRITESHEET for PipaKlub, using INPUT1 as strict creature identity and INPUT2 as ONLY 2D faceted-paper game art style. Absolutely no hippo elements, jewelry, bells, crystals, wings or added back kite. Square preferably2048x2048, EXACT FOUR columns by FOUR rows,16 equally sized cells. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard image, no solid background, no text, numbers, labels, grid lines, portraits or palette. One complete creature per cell, uniform body scale and fixed3/4 front-facing RIGHT view throughout. Occupy only central50-55% of each cell, with WIDE invisible gutters >=20% each side even around extended paper streamers. All extremities fully contained. Crisp dark navy outline with clean neutral alpha antialiasing; NO green screen fringe, neon edge pixels, noisy colored speckles, particles, glows or drop shadows.
STRICT CHARACTER: original floating violet/plum-purple spherical CYCLOPS of faceted folded paper, exactly ONE large blue eye with dark navy pupil and pale ice-blue iris, expressive eyelid, and ONE tiny white triangular fang beneath eye. NO ears, arms, legs or extra eyes. Opaque IVORY folded-paper conical wrapping/hat covers upper half of sphere, broad angular rim above eye, one curled origami hook at its top like a loose bandage folded into a loop. Slender honey-gold bamboo ribs follow polygonal ivory wrapping, tied with small cream string knots at intersections and at rim. Exactly FOUR long cream origami paper streamers continuously attached by string knots beneath the orb: TWO outer strips splay slightly to sides and TWO inner strips hang down; each has broad angular accordion zigzag folds and pointed ends. They are attached ribbon appendages, not severed limbs. Purple body visible under hat, eye never hidden unintentionally. Cream surfaces remain solid opaque paper. Use only plum/violet, ivory, warm tan/gold bamboo, ice blue/navy eye. Preserve creature identity from anime: same curled hat tip, one eye, angular orb, four cream ribbon limbs and little fang.
STYLE: intermediate clean2D illustration and refined pixel-art clusters, bold readable dark outline and 3-tone angular paper shading, compact game-readable silhouette at96px, NO smooth3D plastic, no paint textures.
ANIMATIONORDER left-to-right:
ROW1 IDLE00–03: calm hover; eye glances slightly, brief blink on01, gently bobbing hat with continuous curled top; four streamers sway in a small sequential wave. Final returns near initial.
ROW2 FLIGHT04–07: lean orb slightly forward and let the same four ribbons stream backward in four coherent articulated phases, eye focused. Do not change body size, orientation or ribbon count. No wholefigure translation as a substitute for animation.
ROW3 SKILL08–11: anticipation eye narrows and four ribbons flex inward; charge gathers the four accordion ribbons close around lower orb; release the four attached strips forward/outward like a paper lash while eye opens; recover to original hover. No detached projectiles or large visual effects.
ROW4 HURT12–13: blink/squint recoil with hat tipped slightly and ribbons curled, then reopening eye and recovering. VICTORY14–15: cheerful crescent eye with tiny smiling fang, then proud bright blue eye with four ribbons lifted subtly. Each pose full body.
All16frames must differ through articulation or expression, same orb/head/hat dimensions, no drifting anchors. Actual transparent PNG, clean edges. No extra creatures, props or frames.
